title: Lebesgue differentiation theorem in rescaled form
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let g : ℝⁿ → ℝ be locally integrable with respect to Lebesgue measure Lⁿ (volume on Euclid n). Then for Lⁿ-a.e. v ∈ ℝⁿ: for every R > 0, ∫_{closedBall(0,R)} |g(v + rw) − g(v)| dw → 0 as r ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable g volume → ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid n)), ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, |g (v + r • w) - g v|) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
